title: Page heading of Activity, the scheduled tasks made in conversations. A light, friendly tone.
description: Text under the heading: a task's turns run on the server, in the conversation it came from.
search: Accessible name of the task search box.
search-placeholder: Placeholder of the task search box.
empty.title: Heading shown when there are no tasks; a light, friendly tone.
empty.description: The clock button is in a conversation's composer.
save-failed: Error shown when a task's change didn't save.
interval-prompt: The browser's prompt asking how often the task repeats, in minutes; 0 removes the schedule.
interval-invalid: Error when what was typed isn't a number of minutes.
runs: Under a task: how many runs were kept; <details> links to the schedule's page with its past runs.
repeats: Under a task: {{interval}} is how often it repeats (e.g. "30 min", "2 hr"); <time/> is when it last changed (e.g. "5m ago").
status.queued: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.running: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.paused: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.failed: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.interrupted: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.completed: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.cancelled: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
status.scheduled: A task's status chip. scheduled: it completed and runs again.
actions.pause: Button that pauses a running or queued task.
actions.retry-review: Button for a task interrupted for review (a person had to look first): run it again.
actions.run: Button that runs a finished task again.
actions.pause-schedule: Button that pauses a task's repeats.
actions.edit-schedule: Button that changes how often the task repeats.
actions.set-schedule: Button that makes the task repeat.
crumb: Breadcrumb in the header for the Activity page.
